acceptance_criteria: exact raw artifact identities and hashes are consumed
current source availability cannot substitute for a missing sealed artifact
sources added after the historical run cannot enter replay
changed current source-selection logic cannot alter the sealed input set
NEGATIVE FIXTURE: historical seal A + current manifest containing newer source B -> replay consumes A only

authorization.note: Authority comes from this committed queue record. It does not come from the event that started the run, and it cannot be granted by anything in a workflow input.

commits.note: A head that has moved invalidates this packet.

directive: The seal records an input set and nothing can consume it, so every replay re-selects against today's manifest. Make replay consume the exact historical input manifest the seal references.

must: execute ONLY the task named above
run the required tests through run_suite and report the counts the runner printed
report failures you did not fix, including pre-existing ones
preserve uncertainty rather than narrowing it to look finished -- an UNKNOWN is a real answer
fail closed and say so when evidence you need is absent, rather than inferring it
must_not: create new authority of any kind
modify any queue file, PROJECT_STATE.json, CHATGPT_OUTBOX/ or HANDOFF_LOG.jsonl
authorize, create or start another task
promote Q9 or change its promotion state
use sportsbook prices as predictive football inputs
weaken, skip, disable or quarantine a test to reach green
report a step as succeeded without reading its output

limits.note: Enforced by the workflow, not by this text.
